text:
maya: Heads up — during last night's RBAC migration we found a small set of Vault-wrapped ciphertext blobs in an internal S3 lifecycle export. Not public web, but briefly readable by a partner principal. filing triage here.
aj: ack. timeline and scope? which bucket and how many objects?
sam: about 12 objects in s3://redwood-infra-logs/iam-exports/2023-11-07. objects contain base64 ciphertext and header `wrapped: true; backend=transit; key=wrapping-key-v1; nonce=...` — looks like transit-wrapped ciphertext, not plaintext.
leo: transit ciphertext leak reduces blast radius if wrapping key is secure. do we know IAM on wrapping-key-v1?
aj: wrapping-key-v1 is a GCP KMS key. IAM limited to vault-service-account and ops-kms-rotor. the partner principal got temporary s3:GetObject via a migration ACL for ~90m.
security-bot: alert: audit export job export-20231107 created by terraform-runner at 03:12UTC. vault audit shows no `sys/wrapping/unwrap` calls in that window.
maya: good — no unwraps. still treat as sensitive. mitigation plan below.
sam: proposed immediate actions: 1) revoke leases for affected vault paths 2) rotate transit wrapping key (new key version or name) 3) rewrap ciphertexts into staging then replace in-prod 4) tighten S3 ACLs and revoke partner access 5) add alerts for any unwrap attempts or new decrypter bindings.
leo: add TTL on rewrapped artifacts to limit longevity. can we rewrap without exposing plaintext?
aj: yes. Vault `transit/rewrap` can rewrap ciphertext server-side if Vault has access to both key versions. we'll script streaming rewraps to avoid writing plaintext to disk.
maya: ops-oncall, can we schedule a dry-run then a maintenance window for rewrap?
ops-oncall: available 2200UTC for dry-run. will operate under ops-rotation role, using Workload Identity. will copy objects to a staging prefix first.
sam: short runbook for the job: - copy the 12 objects to staging prefix - create new KMS key version or wrapping-key-v2 and update Vault transit mapping - run streaming `transit/rewrap` for each object writing to staging - validate rewrap by attempting unwrap only in staging with rotor creds (no persistence) - replace production objects and revoke ACLs
aj: also revert the Terraform PR that granted the temporary s3:GetObject to partner-account. apply ASAP.
maya: need a partner disclosure: minimal technical summary, no panic. Sam, can you draft in 60m? cc legal.
sam: will draft: what happened, data exposed (wrapped ciphertexts), no unwrap seen, actions (ACL revoke, key rotation, rewrap, audits), contact.
leo: detection: create rule to page on any `sys/wrapping/unwrap` calls or if any principal is granted `cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for wrapping-key-v1.
security-bot: created SEC-2023-245 assigned to aj + ops-oncall. reminder in 2h.
aj: implementation note: streaming rewrap pseudo: for obj in list(prefix): ciphertext=download(obj); new_cipher=vault_cli('transit/rewrap', ciphertext, key=wrapping-key-v2); upload(staging+obj.key, new_cipher) — ensure short-lived SA token.
ops-oncall: using Workload Identity and least-privilege roles (storage.objects.get/list, create for staging). vault policy scoped to transit:rewrap only.
sam: post-ops: rotate terraform-runner tokens that read that prefix and confirm backup-inspector uses ephemeral creds.
aj: check S3 access logs for any GETs by partner principal during the window; if none, lower severity.
leo: prefer creating a new key name (wrapping-key-v2) rather than reusing v1 to avoid accidental re-use; create new key version in GCP and update Vault mapping, then deprecate v1.
ops-oncall: dry-run underway. will report results once rewrap validation done.
maya: action owners and ETAs: aj: revert TF ACL PR (30m); ops-oncall: staging copy + dry-run at 2200UTC; sam: partner disclosure draft (60m); leo: detection rule & pager (4h); maya: legal coordination & incident summary (2h).
leo: schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow to review runbook gaps and Terraform drift prevention.
maya: thanks everyone, keep updates here. :thumbsup:
